answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 39309 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I am from India. I came in Jeddah few days back, I found people do pray after jamah has been finished Question: I am from India. I came in Jeddah few days back, I found people do pray after jamah has been finished. They make their separate jamah. So I want to ask in India many Ulema told me it cannot be in masjid premises once jamah has been finished. They said you can do another jamah out of masjid premises. My question is that is it allowed to make jamah when jamat has been finished by imam? Answer ID: 39309 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 355/466/N=1433) In the mosque of the locality where imam and muezzin are fixed it is unlawful and makrooh tahrimi to offer salah with jama’ah after the people of the mosque have offered salah in the mosque with azan and iqamah. It is not correct to join such jama’ah. Those who join it do not get the virtues of jama’ah rather due to committing makrooh tahrimi act they become sinful. (For details see: Ma’arif al-Sunan, 2:285-291, Al-Qutoof al-Daniya Fi Tahqiq al-Jamah al-Saniya Dar Talifat Rashidia, p 730-751, Imdad al-Ahkam 2:111, 132-136, 155, Tohfah al-Almai 1:545, 546, and Masail Imamat Mudallal by Hadhrat Mufti Habibur Rahman Khairabadi p 55-59) Yes, in the portion of mosque which is outside the Shariah mosque, if some people whose salah was missed by chance make second jama’ah then it is allowable. And Shariah evidences are the authority, not the sayings or practice of the people of any area especially when it is against Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
